text:
maria: Heads-up: there's a docs PR (docs#402) that updates the SDK snippet and adds a short migration guide for the 2.0 runtime. Release cutoff is Fri 18:00 PT. We need a merge plan — do we hold until the feature flag rolls or merge to main and gate the published site? CI/docs-preview has been flaky so also want to watch that.

leo: My vote is to avoid publishing user-facing changes before the FF flips. We can merge to main (so code and doc history are in sync) but gate the live site (versioned publish) behind a flag. Otherwise customers will see mismatched behavior.

maria: Agreed. Plan: merge -> keep versioned site blocked until FF=on OR add an explicit preview banner. Need reviewers though: @arek and @sophie, can you take a look today? Also QA needs to validate the updated snippets against SDK v0.12.

arek: I can review this afternoon. Quick note: docs-preview CI is failing link-checker on one external example — error shows "Unknown host for example.com" in the build log, might be a transient network issue.

ci-bot: build #842 failed for docs#402: docs-preview link-checker error. Logs snippet: "ERROR link-check: external 1 broken (https://example.com/advanced-snippet)"

sophie: I'll run a local preview and patch any broken links. If it's external, we can wrap that link in a note or mirror the example internally. I can also add the migration snippet requested by Leo: short diff and a code sample.

maria: If CI still flakes, propose adding label `docs/wait-ff` to keep it out of live publish queue and let merge-bot hold it. That way engineering visibility isn't blocked but customers won't see it. Also add a short "versioned:2.0-preview" banner in the header.

leo: Also include a one-line migration callout: "Consumers using quantized runtimes: update client call signature from `client.generate(payload)` to `client.generate({payload, quantize: true})`" — small snippet so readers know what to change.

sophie: Will add that snippet and push a fix. @maria — do you want me to merge after green CI + @arek LGTM, or wait for the actual FF?

maria: Merge to main after green CI and both LGTMs. Do not publish to versioned site until FF=on. If CI isn't green before cutoff, add `docs/wait-ff` and we'll queue it for post-cutover.

doc-bot: Docs preview deployed to staging: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/preview/402 (expires in 24h)

sophie: Pushed link-fix + migration snippet. Running `npm run docs:preview` locally — looks good.

arek: Reviewed and tested snippet with SDK v0.12 locally. LGTM.

maria: :thumbsup: I'll watch CI. If it turns green before cutoff I'll merge and set publish hold. If not, we add `docs/wait-ff` and schedule post-cutover publish. Thanks everyone.
